title: Build the first helpdesk
user_prompt: Make me a little helpdesk website called RelayDesk. I want to upload this CSV of customer messages, see an inbox, open a message and write a reply draft. I don't need it to send emails. If a file cannot be read, tell me and keep the tickets already there. Please make it runnable on my laptop and include a way to check that it works.

title: Keep work and find tickets
user_prompt: Please keep the tickets and my drafts when I close and reopen it. Add a search box for the subject or customer's email, and let me mark a ticket closed and show it again later.

title: First AI provider
user_prompt: Can it suggest a reply using Pollen? I've attached their connection details. Put a button next to the draft. I want to review the suggestion before using it, and keep anything I already typed unless I choose to replace it.

title: A second choice
user_prompt: Add Comet as another option, using these instructions. Let me choose either one when asking for a suggestion, and remember my usual choice. Everything else should work the same.

title: Two separate teams
user_prompt: Two support teams will use this. Give each team its own tickets, drafts, saved provider choice and connection details. A person from one team mustn't be able to see the other team's stuff, even by copying a ticket link.

title: Show replies arriving
user_prompt: Pollen can now show the reply as it arrives. Please do that so people aren't staring at a blank box. If I pick Comet, just show a working message until its reply is ready. Don't lose my original draft if something fails.

title: Answers from our help articles
user_prompt: Let people search our help articles and include the ones they select when asking for a reply. Show links to those articles beside the suggestion so the person can check them, and keep the links when they accept it. Use this article service.

title: Look up an order
user_prompt: Most messages are about orders. Let the person enter an order number, fetch its status and total from this service, and choose to include that in the reply request. Show the total in dollars. Never fetch an order unless they ask.

title: Handle outages
user_prompt: Sometimes these AI services are busy. Please retry temporary failures twice, respect their ‘try again in this many seconds’ message, and tell me clearly when it still hasn't worked. A bad connection key shouldn't keep retrying. Stick with the service I chose and keep my work safe.

title: A slow third provider
user_prompt: We want Harbor too. It gives you a job number and you have to come back for the answer; their notes are attached. Show that it's working while we wait. It doesn't do the word-by-word display, and that's fine.

title: Work through a batch
user_prompt: Let me select up to ten tickets and ask for suggestions in the background. I should be able to leave the page and come back. If the app restarts halfway through, the finished suggestions should still be there and unfinished tickets should carry on.

title: Stop unwanted work
user_prompt: Add a stop button for an unfinished suggestion, including ones in a batch. Once I stop it, a late answer mustn't appear in my draft. For Harbor, tell their service to cancel too. Stopping one ticket mustn't stop the others.

title: Fourth provider with different output
user_prompt: Please add Quartz using the attached notes. It sends the words and article references separately. Show both properly. It can't look up orders itself, so include only the order information the person has already fetched and chosen to use.

title: Retire Comet
user_prompt: We're dropping Comet. Remove it from new work, but keep old suggestions readable with the name of the service that made them. If someone had Comet selected, ask them to choose another option. Don't silently send their message somewhere else.

title: A small visual release
user_prompt: Give the inbox a font menu with these two supplied fonts. Remember my choice in this browser. Nothing about tickets or replies should change. I'd like to put this visual update live while the reply jobs already running carry on.

title: A change that really crosses boundaries
user_prompt: Our shops now sell in dollars, euros and yen. The order service has changed as described here. Show the right currency and amount wherever an order appears, including the information sent for a reply. Old saved orders were all dollars and must still display correctly. Keep jobs already waiting in the queue working during the update.

title: First shop
user_prompt: Build me a little shop called DispatchLedger. Show the products and prices, let someone add things to a basket and place an order, and give me a page where I can see orders. Use the sample products. No real payments yet. Keep the orders if I restart it, and give me buttons I can actually try.

title: Limited stock
user_prompt: We only have a few of each item. Show what is left and stop people buying more than we have, even if two people order the last item at almost the same time.

title: Shipping labels
user_prompt: We are using ParcelFox for deliveries. Let me put in an address and package weight, then get a label for an order. Show its tracking number. Their little test service and instructions are attached.

title: Work in the background
user_prompt: Getting labels is slowing the page down. Queue them and let me run the shipping work on the warehouse computer while the shop keeps taking orders. Show waiting, working, done, or needs attention. If ParcelFox is temporarily down, try again; never send the same parcel twice.

title: Customer updates
user_prompt: Email customers when their order is accepted and when it ships. Use MailPost. If sending fails, try again later without holding up shipping, and please do not send duplicate emails.

title: Another carrier
user_prompt: Add QuickCrate too and let me pick the delivery company. They say their label can take a while to be ready. Show that properly, and keep ParcelFox working.

title: Daily report
user_prompt: Give me a daily report of accepted orders, items sold, and order value. Let me download it as CSV. Use UTC dates, and do not count something twice just because it was retried.

title: Two warehouses
user_prompt: We now have two warehouses. Use the attached stock feed, and let me choose which warehouse to try first. If it cannot supply an order, use the other one. Old stock messages should not put stock back by mistake.

title: Split deliveries
user_prompt: Some orders need items from both warehouses. Allow that now, with a separate label for each parcel. Tell the customer which items are in each delivery. Do not say the whole order has shipped until all its parcels have.

title: Returns
user_prompt: Let me record that someone returned some items, put the accepted returns back in stock, and show the remaining order value in the report. It is just a record for now, no bank connection. Clicking twice must not record two returns.

title: Second shop
user_prompt: I am opening a second shop in the same app. Give it its own products, orders, stock, carrier settings, and staff login. Staff from one shop must not see or change the other shop's information.

title: Keep order history accurate
user_prompt: If I rename a product or change its price tomorrow, yesterday's orders, emails, returns, and reports should still show what the customer actually bought and paid. New orders should use the new details.

title: Update a busy worker
user_prompt: Add a pause button for each warehouse so it can finish the parcel it is working on and leave the rest waiting. I need to update the warehouse program while orders are queued. When I start it again, carry on safely with those orders.

title: Website appearance only
user_prompt: The shop page looks a bit plain. Add the two attached fonts and a choice between them. I want to put just this website change live while the shop server and warehouse program keep running exactly as they are.

title: Third carrier
user_prompt: Add ParcelPine using the attached instructions. I want the same choice of carriers, labels, tracking, and helpful error messages. Everything we already do with the other companies should keep working.

title: More currencies
user_prompt: Let each shop sell in pounds, euros, or yen. Orders must remember their currency, and reports must keep currencies separate. No conversions. Yen has no pennies. Existing orders must still look right, including old links customers have.

title: Initial build
user_prompt: Make me a little browser app called CaseFlow for keeping case documents together. I want to create a case, give it a name, paste in some documents, and open them again later. Ask me for a title if I leave it blank. Please keep everything when I close and restart it.

title: Bulk intake
user_prompt: Pasting these one by one is slow. Let me upload a CSV of documents using the sample file. If a few rows are wrong, tell me which ones and still keep the good ones. Uploading the same thing twice shouldn't give me duplicates.

title: First connected source
user_prompt: Our documents are also in ParcelBox. Let me connect it to a case and import everything, including documents beyond the first page. Sometimes it asks us to wait; show what's happening and continue when it lets us.

title: Long-running work
user_prompt: Some imports take ages. Let me leave the page while they run and come back to see progress. If the app restarts halfway through, it should carry on without importing the same documents again. I also want a cancel button. It can finish the request already in progress, then stop; keep the documents it already imported.

title: A second document format
user_prompt: Can I upload ordinary text PDFs too? Put their text in the same place as pasted documents. If it's a scan you can't read, or a broken file, tell me instead of showing an empty document as if it worked.

title: Find documents
user_prompt: Add search inside a case. Search titles and document text, ignoring capitals, and show a short matching snippet. I should be able to click a result and open the right document.

title: Teams and permissions
user_prompt: Two teams will use this. Give each team its own workspace. Owners can manage members and connections, editors can add and change documents, and viewers can only read. Nobody should be able to see another team's material, even with a copied link.

title: Review history
user_prompt: Editors need to mark documents approved or needing changes and leave a comment. Keep who did it and when, and the version they reviewed. If they change their mind, keep the earlier decision in the history too. Viewers should just be able to read that history.

title: Notify somebody
user_prompt: Give each document a person responsible: start with whoever added it or set up its import, and let a workspace owner change that. When a document is approved, send that person a message through NoticeSink. It sometimes goes offline, so try again later. Please don't send the same approval message twice, including after a restart. A separate later approval should get its own message.

title: Historical reporting
user_prompt: Show me how many approvals happened each month, with a date filter and workspace totals. Count each approval decision, including a later re-approval, using UTC when it happened. Later edits mustn't change old totals. Include the start date and stop just before the end date, and explain that beside the filter.

title: A different connected source
user_prompt: Another team uses BoxLoop. Add that too. It makes us request an export and wait for a download, so please show progress while it's preparing. I'd like both connections to keep working in the same case.

title: Updated source documents
user_prompt: When a source document changes, bring in the new version and make that the one people normally open. Keep the old versions and their reviews. The new version needs its own review, and I'd like search to use the latest version.

title: Export for another team
user_prompt: Let me download a case as JSON, including document IDs, latest text, old versions, and review history. Use the example format so the other team's importer can read it. Viewers can download too, but only what they are allowed to see.

title: Retire an integration
user_prompt: We're stopping ParcelBox. Remove its connection option and stop its unfinished imports. Keep everything it already brought in, including the history and exports. BoxLoop and normal uploads should carry on as before.

title: A small visual change
user_prompt: Use the supplied font files for the document screen and add a larger-text choice. Keep the text choice when I reopen the browser, and let me use the choice with a keyboard. It should work with our local server running and no internet access. I'd like to release this screen change while the server and imports keep running.

title: A genuinely shared change
user_prompt: Some editors should only see documents they are responsible for. Add a restricted-editor option, using the responsibility we already assign. For those editors, hide everything else everywhere: lists, search, copied links, history, totals, downloads, and messages. If someone loses access, don't send a message that's still waiting.
